title: Knowledge-Enriched Structured EHR Features for 30-Day Hospital Readmission Prediction on MIMIC-IV
abstract: arXiv:2609.15713v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent approaches to 30-day hospital readmission prediction rely on pre-trained language models applied to discharge summaries. Although these methods achieve strong performance, they depend on the availability of clinical notes, incur substantial computational costs, and yield representations that lack interpretability. We propose a knowledge-enriched feature representation that augments structured Electronic Health Record (EHR) data with four medical knowledge sources: disease ontology mapping, procedure classification, drug ingredient vocabulary, and organ system laboratory aggregation, without using clinical notes. Each feature dimension corresponds to a named clinical concept, yielding a sparse and interpretable patient representation. The approach is evaluated with six classifiers on a MIMIC-IV v2.2 cohort. translated_title: 基于知识增强的结构化电子健康记录特征用于MIMIC-IV上的30天再入院预测
translated_abstract: 近期的30天医院再入院预测方法依赖于应用于出院小结的预训练语言模型。尽管这些方法取得了强大的性能，但它们依赖于临床记录的可用性，产生大量的计算成本，并且所得到的表示缺乏可解释性。我们提出了一种知识增强的特征表示方法，在不使用临床记录的情况下，通过四种医学知识来源增强结构化电子健康记录（EHR）数据：疾病本体映射、手术操作分类、药物成分词汇表以及基于器官系统的实验室指标聚合。每个特征维度都对应一个命名的临床概念，从而产生稀疏且可解释的患者表示。该方法在MIMIC-IV v2.2队列上使用六种分类器进行评估。在20折交叉验证下，最佳配置达到了0.743的AUROC。该性能与预训练语言模型方法相当。
tldr: 本研究提出一种无需临床文本记录、融合疾病本体、手术分类、药物词汇和器官系统实验室指标四种医学知识源的可解释结构化EHR特征表示方法，用于30天再入院预测，在MIMIC-IV数据集上达到了与预训练语言模型相当的0.743 AUROC性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an interpretable, knowledge-enriched structured EHR feature representation—combining disease ontology mapping, procedure classification, drug vocabulary, and organ-system laboratory aggregation without requiring clinical notes—for 30-day hospital readmission prediction, achieving an AUROC of 0.743 on MIMIC-IV that is comparable to pre-trained language model approaches.
